items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: Sonny Sharrock taught me about that kind of thing. I studied with Sonny, a guitarist.

ctx.x: It’s an interesting thing because it’s hard to really define it. It’s not like they’re playing louder or they’re playing more. It’s just magic.

Yeah. It’s what they do, how they do, what they do. I’ll put it like that. It’s what they do, how they do it and with what they do. And it just woof — yeah. Sonny Sharrock taught me about that kind of thing. I studied with Sonny, a guitarist.
